title: Diaxi — złapanie ręcznika
description: Przebitka 26 klatek / 1,083 s po rzucie Zosi. Diaxi po PRAWEJ, twarz i spojrzenie w LEWO ku Zosi poza kadrem. Ręcznik przyszedł z LEWEJ na PRAWĄ; już złapany oburącz przy piersi, luźny koniec jeszcze opada. Nie otula jeszcze ramion. Mokre włosy, listopadowy chłód, jezioro za nią i po prawej. Kamera 75 mm po tej samej stronie osi co 13 i 14. Aktualny montaż: start 1191f, długość 26f (1.083 s), wejście źródła 0f.

prompts.image: Create ONE photorealistic live-action cinematic 16:9 insert 1920x1080. Image1 is the established towel throw: exact shore geometry, wet Diaxi wardrobe, pose direction and gray November daylight. Image2 locks Diaxi's exact face and forehead mark ONLY, ignore its night/fire lighting. Image3 locks the burgundy terry towel with twin charcoal bands, ONE towel not two. Cut to 75mm eye-level medium close shot of DIAXI on SCREEN RIGHT, framed head to waist with both hands fully visible. Same side of the action axis as image1. She faces three-quarter SCREEN LEFT, nose pointing LEFT, eyes lifted LEFT toward Zosia OFFSCREEN LEFT. Land/reed edge left, open gray lake behind/right. She has JUST CAUGHT the towel thrown FROM LEFT TO RIGHT: both natural hands already grip the loosely folded burgundy towel at upper chest height, elbows still slightly forward toward left, soft fabric compressing from the catch. One loose corner hangs down and slightly to screen right with residual momentum; towel NOT wrapped around shoulders yet. Her soaked highlighted brown braids and strands cling naturally to neck and original opaque ivory embroidered sleeves, water droplets on hands and face, shoulders slightly hunched with cold. Original costume unchanged, towel covers the central chest. Reserved fatigued alert expression, mouth barely parted after a breath, no smile or glamor pose. Preserve exact face likeness, hair and forehead symbol, correct two arms and anatomically natural fingers gripping fabric, human scale and natural 75mm perspective. Defocused November reeds, gray water and opposite shore soft; no new buildings, no waterfall. No Zosia in the close framing, no second towel, no magic, no extra limbs, no written words or watermark. A convincing match-on-action catch insert, dynamic fabric but crisp face.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.35s: DIAXI already grips the caught towel with both hands; her elbows yield slightly toward her chest, absorbing its left-to-right momentum. 0.35–1.08s: the loose corner drops under gravity as she steadies the towel, keeping her face and gaze toward screen LEFT at Zosia offscreen. 1.08–3.0s: hold with a small cold shiver. Camera: locked 75mm medium close shot. Droplets fall from wet hair and sleeves. @Image1 preserves the existing DIAXI’s identity only, not its nighttime lighting; @Image2 preserves the single burgundy towel and charcoal bands. Keep November daylight and lake geometry. No second catch, wrapping shoulders yet, smile, rightward look, new people, extra hands, cuts, morphing, text or watermark. Performance: chilled, tired and reserved; no smile, laughter or sudden emotional recovery.
